item.title: Harborough Firefighters Tackle 4×4 Blaze
item.description: A 4×4 caught fire in Husbands Bosworth on Saturday morning. Firefighters from Market Harborough were called to High Street at 10.45am and quickly extinguished the blaze involving a Ford Ranger, which was deemed accidental. The road was closed while emergency services dealt with the incident. There were no injuries.
